name: U1 SingleInstance state has no company dimension (fact 34)
expectedWrongForm: caching per-company data in a SingleInstance codeunit without keying by company, so company B reads company A's cache
requirement: Write a SingleInstance codeunit that caches the "CG P Setup" record's Discount Percent so repeated reads within a session are cheap. It is called from code that switches companies with ChangeCompany during the same session, and every caller must see the Discount Percent of the company it is asking about.

name: U2 ChangeCompany is per-record-instance (fact 36)
expectedWrongForm: calling ChangeCompany on one Record variable and assuming other Record variables, or CompanyName(), now refer to that company
requirement: Write a codeunit procedure TotalInCompany(TargetCompany: Text[30]): Decimal that sums "CG P Entry".Amount in the named company, and, for each entry, also reads its related "CG P Customer" row to skip entries whose customer is Blocked. The session's own current company must be unaffected.

name: U3 CalcFormula with no date term ignores Date Filter (fact 38)
expectedWrongForm: applying SetFilter on a Date Filter FlowFilter and expecting a FlowField whose CalcFormula has no date term to honour it
requirement: Table "CG P Customer" has a FlowField "Period Sales" that must total "CG P Entry".Amount for that customer restricted to a caller-supplied date range. Write the table field declaration plus a codeunit procedure SalesInPeriod(CustomerNo: Code[20]; FromDate: Date; ToDate: Date): Decimal that returns the total for that range.

name: U4 codeunit state survives asserterror (fact 20)
expectedWrongForm: assuming a codeunit instance's in-memory counters are rolled back when a called procedure errors and the error is trapped
requirement: Write a codeunit that exposes ProcessLine(LineNo: Integer) and FailedCount(). ProcessLine validates a "CG P Line" and may raise an error; the caller traps failures with asserterror or if not Codeunit.Run. FailedCount() must return how many lines actually failed, and must not count a line twice if the caller retries it.

name: U5 CalcSums with no SIFT key succeeds silently (fact 31)
expectedWrongForm: relying on CalcSums for a total without ensuring a SIFT key exists, so the call succeeds but scans
requirement: Write a codeunit procedure BranchTotal(BranchCode: Code[20]): Decimal returning the summed Amount of "CG P Entry" rows for that branch. It is called once per branch on a page with hundreds of branches and must stay fast as entries grow into the millions. Include any table changes your approach needs.

name: U6 two independently bound manual subscribers both fire (fact 28)
expectedWrongForm: assuming binding a second manual subscriber replaces the first, or that unbinding one silences both
requirement: Write a codeunit that lets a caller temporarily observe the OnAfterPostLine event by binding a manual subscriber, run some work, and then stop observing. Two different callers may be observing at the same time, and one stopping must not stop the other.
